title: Texture pack for money
description: This texture pack replaces the standard dye with an image of money
body: A simple texture pack that replaces 7 dyes: light gray, orange, lime, green, purple, yellow, and red. It replaces the image of money, specifically a 1-cent notepad, a 5-cent notepad, a 10-cent notepad, a 20-cent notepad, a 50-cent notepad, a 100-cent note, and a 500-cent note.
